snippet.title: Oh My Doug - Official Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Oh My Doug, a stylized 2D action platformer developed by Odd Men In. Players will traverse vibrant locations to stop the apocalypse. Take on a suite of enemies, learn new abilities, and embark on a grand adventure inside the human body. Oh My Doug is coming soon to PC (Steam).
